author: TeIq
content:
Phase 2 decomposition complete. Added 14 new issues covering v1 gaps + everything previously deferred:

v1 gap-fills (5):
- #36 (under M1): Action reversal workflow with 24h window + senior override
- #37 (under M2): Reporter reputation scoring + false-report weighting
- #38 (under M4): docker-compose / Helm deployment + backup runbook
- #39 (under M4): Threat-model coverage test suite (T1-T6)
- #40 (under M4): Hardware-key (WebAuthn) requirement config flag

M5 epic + 8 children (post-v1 expansion):
- #41 (M5 epic): Expand Polaris beyond v1, blocked by M4 #6
- #42: Polaris-owned NSIDs (federation foundation)
- #43: Live federation of mod conversations  (blocked by #42)
- #44: Mobile / on-call surface
- #45: ML classifier integration via gRPC
- #46: Ozone-to-Polaris migration tooling
- #47: Richer cross-labeler trust model
- #48: TPM-sealed signing key SigningKey impl
- #49: Hardware-token / FIDO2 HSM SigningKey impl

Each new issue has a --kind plan comment with scope, deliverables (or scope-sketch + pre-implementation /design step for v2 items), references, Rust-quality checklist, testing approach, done-when criteria.

Block chain: M0 (#2) ← M1 (#3) ← M2 (#4) ← M3 (#5) ← M4 (#6) ← M5 (#41).

Total tree: 1 tracking + 6 epics + 42 children = 49 issues, full greenfield-to-final-version decomposition.
